answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 44319 Country: India Title: The Process of Namaz and book describing Sunnat Question: I would like to know what should we think during salah. Please also refer me an English book which has all the sunnah of the holy Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). Answer ID: 44319 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 512/319/L=1434) (1) While offering salah we bring the magnificence and glory of Allah in our heart in a way that we are seeing Allah. If it is not possible then at least we should think that Allah is seeing us. (2) You should see the book: Uswa-e-Rasool Akram (The Life and Teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) by Dr Muhammad Abdul Hai, Pakistan. (Internet Dept.) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
